programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. programme.title: My Life with James Dean
programme.desc: Invited to present his first feature film "My life with James Dean" in Normandy, the young director G√©raud Champreux has no idea this film tour is about to change his life.

programme.title: The Falls: Covenant of Grace
programme.desc: This third and final film of the Falls trilogy revisits former Mormon missionaries Chris and RJ, six years after they first fell in love and were disciplined for it, as they formulate a plan to be together at long last.

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: A Brother in the Catholic Church must choose between his vow of chastity and the man he loves.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: The Swordsman [English Dub]
programme.desc: Blinded swordsman faces a dangerous quest to save his daughter, unsheathing his sword once more for justice.

programme.title: Immortal Demon Slayer [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The tale of Wukong, the legendary monkey warrior, and his journey to the Immortal Mountain to cultivate his kung-fu skills.

programme.title: No Heaven, But Love [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Set in 1999's rampant violence, the story follows the intense bond of friendship between girls during a scorching summer.

programme.title: Love in the Big City [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Characterized by her sharp tongue and daring attitude, Jae-hee is always at the center of gossip and hateful rumors. Meanwhile, Heung-soo is set on keeping his gay identity a secret for life. One day, in the back alley of a hotel, Jae-hee discovers Heung-soo’s secret by chance.

programme.title: Tube [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A touching action epic about an all-out war between a subway terrorist who holds a city hostage and the detective who risks his life to save everyone. It's the heart-wrenching story of love and sacrifice that grows in a desperate situation, and the humanity of people trying to save others in the face of extreme danger at breath-taking speeds and on a huge scale.

programme.title: Warrior King [English Dub]
programme.desc: In this epic true story inspired by the legend of King Gesar, a young man grows up in exile in a world overrun by demons and monsters. When evil forces threaten his home, he returns to save his people and embrace his destiny as great hero and ruler.

programme.title: Alivehoon [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A drift team on the verge of shutting down scouts out Koichi Oba, a shy, introverted gamer who is incredibly talented at Esport driving games. Koichi demonstrates his mastery in a real car, but he is up against professional drivers who challenge him in races of life and death. Koichi's blossoming technique, passion, courage, and teamwork break down the barriers between the virtual and the real, taking him and his team to new extremes. This is the birth of the fastest, most precise race movie ever filmed. A new world where gamers reach high for the pinnacle of real-life drifting. This is a film about what happens when you push past your limits.

programme.title: The Divine Fury [English Dub]
programme.desc: Champion fighter Yong-hu seeks aid from a priest when strange wounds appear on his palms, leading to a battle against evil.

programme.title: A Man of Reason [English Dub]
programme.desc: After 10 years in the prison on behalf of his boss, Soo-hyuk is released, but the boss doubts his loyalty. When Soo-hyuk visits his long-abandoned girlfriend, he finds out that he, now, is a father of young girl. He wants to cut ties with the gang, but the boss is not ready to release him, and hires a notorious killer. The killer takes the daughter as hostage, and Soo-hyuk decides to take revenge in a way that he's best at; violence.

programme.title: The Villainess [English Dub]
programme.desc: An assassin seeks revenge after secrets ruin her chance at freedom, unleashing her deadly skills in a bloody rampage.

programme.title: My Daughter is a Zombie [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lee Jeong-hwan, a fierce animal trainer, lives a chaotic daily life with his rebellious teenage daughter, Lee Su-a who is full of passion for dancing. One day, Su-a becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. In a desperate bid to protect her, Jeong-hwan takes Su-a to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Kim Bam-sun, lives. Amid growing societal pressure to root out the infected, Jeong-hwan notices that Su-a, despite being a zombie, vaguely understands human speech and reacts to her favorite things: dancing and her grandmother’s sharp but loving flicks of the hand. Refusing to give up on her, Jeong-hwan draws on his years of experience as a tiger trainer and begins an intensive training program for his zombie daughter. A training journey more terrifying than handling a tiger and more difficult than dealing with teenage angst begins. The most heartwarming and hilarious top-secret project is about to unfold!

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Shanghai [English Dub]
programme.desc: A laborer moves to Shanghai in the hope of becoming rich. But ends up using his kung fu skills to survive. Remake of The Boxer From Shantung.

programme.title: RAGING FIRE [English Dub]
programme.desc: Cheung Sung-bong is a highly respected cop with a long history of success in dangerous cases. However, his past soon comes back to haunt him when a former protégé resurfaces, seeking revenge.

programme.title: Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Rohan is called to assist in the strange sale of a mansion in a rural village whose citizens have all somehow become rich.

programme.desc: Celebrate Asia’s biggest stars in iconic dramas and hit films! From heartthrobs to legends, enjoy fan-favorite performances 24/7.

programme.title: Burning [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When the woman he loves disappears, a young man’s suspicions spin out of control during his frantic search.

programme.title: Seducing Mr. Perfect [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Idealistic, romantic and perpetually suffering from it, Min-jun is yet again pondering over a recent break-up when she gets into a fender bender with a man named Robin Heiden, who turns out to be her new hotshot boss from the US.

programme.title: The Way Home [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Seven-year-old Sang Woo is left with his grandmother in a remote village while his mother looks for work. Born and raised in the city, Sang Woo quickly comes into conflict with his old-fashioned grandmother and his new rural surroundings. Disrespectful and selfish, Sang Woo lashes out in anger, perceiving that he has been abandoned. He trades his grandmother's only treasure for a video game; he throws his food and he throws tantrums. When Sang Woo's mother finds work and finally returns for him, Sang Woo has become a different boy. Through his grandmother's boundless patience and devotion, he learns to embrace empathy, humility, and the importance of family.

programme.title: River [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: On a calm winter’s day in Kibune, Kyoto, a mountain inn and its staff all find themselves trapped in a time loop.

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: Midnight [English Dub]
programme.desc: The witness who is unable to hear, becomes the serial killer's next target! 'Kyung-mi' who is deaf, was on the way home when she witnessed 'So-jung' bleeding out on the road. In her attempt to help, she becomes the new target of serial killer 'Do-shik.' 'Kyung-mi' runs in desperation and willingness to survive but cannot hear even the murderer's footsteps! During the night, in the middle of Seoul, begins the unstoppable chase between a serial killer and his newest target, 'Kyung-mi'! An extreme silent chase thriller!

programme.title: The Time of Fever [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ho-tae and Dong-hui, childhood friends who grew up like brothers, reunite when Ho-tae returns to Gangneung for his father's funeral. Dong-hui, having been kicked out after coming out, now lives alone in Ho-tae's empty house. As they begin living together, Dong-hui struggles with his feelings for Ho-tae, his first love. Ho-tae, too, starts experiencing unfamiliar emotions. To cope, Ho-tae dates recklessly, which hurts Dong-hui. After an unexpected incident, their delicate relationship begins to change.

programme.title: The Terror Live [English Dub]
programme.desc: A newsman discovers he's been rigged with a bomb after he has an exclusive interview with a terrorist who blew up a bridge.

programme.title: Miss Baek [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Sang-a, or Miss Baek, was convicted of a crime because she tried to defend herself. Now she doesn't believe in people, let alone love them. She is about to move to Jeju, and her "friend" Jang-seob, the detective for Sang-a's case, cannot hold her down. One day, Sang-a meets a small girl from her neighborhood. Her body gets covered with bruises; she wears a pajama on the bone-chilling winter night. The girl, Ji-eun, has been abused by his father, Il-gon, and his girlfriend, Mi-kyung, for a long time. As an abused and neglected child, Sang-a tries and fails to "save" her. When Ji-eun escapes her house after getting brutally beaten, Sang-a grabs her and runs away. Il-gon and Mi-kyung reported the abduction while finding Ji-eun to remove the evidence. To protect the girl, Sang-a steps up and fights against the abuser.

programme.title: The Villainess [English Dub]
programme.desc: An assassin seeks revenge after secrets ruin her chance at freedom, unleashing her deadly skills in a bloody rampage.

programme.desc: Eagle Chief Yoh Xi-hung raises orphans to be his personal killers. One such is Chik Ming-sing who now wants to put his killer life behind him. Now they will team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Tentacle 8
programme.desc: A mysterious computer virus wipes out highly classified personnel files at the NSA, prompting a top secret investigation. Raymond Berry, an NSA operative suspected of crimes against the United States, risks his life to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Susie's Hope
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the inspirational relationship between Donna Lawrence (Emmanuelle Vaguer) a pit bull attack survivor, and Susie (Susie Lawrence), an abused pit bull-mix puppy, as they learn to heal and forgive together.

programme.title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
programme.desc: Surrounded by wealth and living with abundant resources in Manhattan, 12-year-old cello prodigy Reggie, lives a solitary life lacking only frequently absent parents and friends. Estranged from family, having slacker boyfriend troubles, and fired from her waitressing job, sometimes musician 23-year-old Eleanor needs a new place to live and a new job.

programme.title: Watercolor Postcards
programme.desc: A small town girl with a troubled past returns home only to find that both her sister and her hometown are in peril. Only when she falls for a man who similarly has dark days behind him will they muster up the faith and love needed to save the things they hold dear in life.

programme.title: Walt Before Mickey
programme.desc: A young man named Walt Disney had big dreams, and no matter how many obstacles he had to face he never gave up--from his tumultuous childhood, to serving his country, to borrowing money, to the creation of his first iconic animated character Mickey Mouse.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: its the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears and find faith in himself, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.desc: El Doctor Anselmi está esperando a Inés que le viene a traer alguna ropa a Betania. Y se van a hablar al consultorio. Cuando llegan él le dice que de acuerdo a los últimos exámenes y la junta médica hacía pocos momentos, lamentablemente Betania no tenía sino unos 6 meses de vida. Inés se desespera, se pone a llorar, a gritar. Sale de la clínica y se pone a pensar en algunos parajes con su hermana. Sigue llorando y no entiende porque después de tantos años sin tenerla, ahora que la encontró la vida se la lleva. No entiende esa justicia. Diego Andrés llega a su consultorio y encuentra sentada en su silla a Michelle.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro comienzan a hacer averiguaciones y descubren que alguien asesinó a los verdaderos padres de Sol para luego entregarla a Raúla y su marido, por lo que van a visitar a Heriberto Madroño a la cárcel para averiguar quién cometió ese crimen. Allí se encuentran, para sorpresa, con Heriberto y Reina, donde Reina obliga a Heriberto a confesar que él cometió el crimen para quedarse con su fortuna. Él lo niega y está a punto de contarle la verdad a Sol.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto termina por confesarle a Sol que fue él quien mató a sus padres por encargo, pero Solo le dirá quién lo mandó a matarlos si ella lo perdona. Sol no logra perdonarlo. Luego, Sol habla con Maricielo, y esta le recomienda que vaya a hablar con Eloy para concluir el tema de la relación de los Monserrat con el asesinato. Eloy le cuenta que hace veinte años, ellos eran socios con una pareja que murió asesinada, y que su hija había desaparecido. Carlos visita a Maricielo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Reina le pide a Sol y a Alejandro que dejen de averiguar sobre el pasado de Sol y comiencen a preocuparse por su propia relación, proponiéndole además a Sol ayudarla a organizar su boda, pero Sol no conforme, hace una visita por su cuenta a Heriberto Madroño. Ella decide perdonarlo a cambio de la verdad sobre quién lo contrató para matar a sus padres. Él de devela que fue Reina quien lo hizo, para quedarse con toda su fortuna, por lo que Sol ahora se queda preocupada.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro le propone matrimonio a Sol, pero ella le explica que no puede aceptarlo porque Heriberto Madroño le confesó que él había matado a sus padres por encargue de Reina. Cuando ella se lo cuenta a Alejandro, él estalla de furia, ya que no puede creer que Sol considere la posibilidad de que Reina sea cómplice de un asesinato. Van a visitar a Heriberto, y él lo reitera en la cara de Alejandro, incluyendo que tiene pruebas. Pero Alejandro se rehúsa a creerlo y esto genera conflicto con Sol.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol termina con Alejandro y este queda destrozado. Esa misma noche, aprovechando su tristeza, Aída lo seduce y lo lleva a la cama. Entretanto, Madroño usurpa la identidad de un preso quemado y logra escapar de prisión. De inmediato va a casa de Sol para decirle que él puede probar que Reina mandó a matar a sus verdaderos padres. Maricielo recibe un extraño mensaje de Alicia ("Beatriz") y eso le hace sospechar de la fidelidad de Carlos.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En el gimnasio Brigitte Ana y Finita ejecutan una rutina de ejercicios entre tanto critican el desempeño de los hombres como esposos y jefes de familia | las tres mujeres se unen para hacer una guerra frontal en contra de los hombres que supuestamente ellas coartan su libertad y su derecho a ejercer libremente el feminismo | Briggite se muestra particularmente afectada al considerar a su esposo Junior un irresponsable e inmaduro incapaz de apoyarla en sus mas criticas decisiones.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En el local nocturno Yubiri excede sus propias expectativas en cuanto al pronostico de la bruja al ser tocada por Wilker y Juan Diego como antesala de llevar a cumplir su sueño de encontrar al hombre de su vida | Yubiri discute con Wilker mostrándole así su rechazo tras haber escogido de antemano a Juan Diego como su hombre ideal. En la madrugada de la media noche Briggite sintiéndose harta de la actitud acomodadiza de su esposo Junior toma la seria decisión de apartarlo de su lado.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En el centro comercial Wilker se reencuentra con Yubiri quien a pesar de su frustrado intento por hacerse recordar por Juan Diego retoma las esperanzas de sentirse una mujer inolvidable gracias a Wilker | Yubiri se despide rápidamente de Wilker al tener la firme esperanza de volver a toparse con Juan Diego. En las instalaciones del gimnasio Gisela indaga sobre la vida personal d Juan Diego al permitirse la confianza de su efímera relación con Atanasio | Juan Diego se presenta humilde.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Briggite se muestra dispersa al recibir la visita llegada de Wilker solo dejándose impresionar por el juvenil porte del muchacho que llega a su casa a tomar las medidas para el camino de la decoración de sus cortinas | Briggite bromea con Wilker intentando ocultar su vulnerabilidad de mujer al sentirse seriamente afectada por la galanura y juventud del nuevo empleado de Botero. Carolina logra acaparar todo el interés de Juan Diego al haberlo impresionado con su físico y belleza.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri furiosa se separa de Wilker después de que la besara en la tarima | discute con él pero éste feliz la deja marchar. Brigitte se lamenta de su soledad ahora que no tiene a Junior y su madre que la oye comienza a hablarle y le aconseja que se busque otro hombre que ella también fue joven y recuerdan a Junior con sus cuentos eternos sobre su actuación en la guerrilla urbana. Mientras que Junior al lado de Olegario y junto a otras mujeres ciertamente está recordando la guerrilla urbana.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo e Irene discuten sobre una cantidad de dinero que ella obtuvo sin su autorización. Leonardo le pregunta a Irene para qué pidió esa plata y ella se niega a decirle. Leo acusa a Julio de haberle robado el dinero, agrediéndolo durante el desayuno. Leonardo decide llevarse a Leo a la oficina. Alejandra le cuenta sus planes contra Irene a Rodrigo, pidiéndole ayuda. Virginia se presenta ante el tribunal para apelar por la libertad condicional. Zulay le cuenta a Trinidad de la mentira que tuvo que decirle a María Lucía. Alejandra discute con Leonardo por cómo deben proceder ante la falta de Irene, acusándolo de desautorizarla. Cuando Leonardo va a disculparse ella aprovecha el momento y lo besa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Luego del juicio Virginia es liberada con la condición de cumplir sus años restantes de condena con libertad condicional. Julio le roba el dinero a Leo y cuando Oriana y Jorge van con el afán de recuperarlo él se los niega burlándose. Sandra insiste con que Virginia está ocultando algo e incita a María Lucía a seguir a Virginia luego de que se la encuentran saliendo del hospital. Irene le sugiere a Leonardo de que un empleo en la empresa sería la muestra de confianza que Leo precisa, con lo cual encomienda a Alejandra que lo ubique en algún departamento del laboratorio. Rodrigo amenaza a Leo y le reclama el dinero. Leonardo interviene y su hijo se ve obligad a confesarle toda la verdad.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Virginia visita la tumba de Miguel Ferrándiz y le promete que no va a descansar hasta encontrar el verdadero culpable de su crimen. Los hermanitos de Julio tiran a la piscina toda la plata que él le robo a Leo. Alejandra le consiguió a Leo un puesto de trabajo en la empresa de la familia Ferrándiz. El doctor de Trinidad le manifiesta que está muy grave porque tienen comprometido los dos riñones y que es posible la idea de un trasplante. Leonardo le pide a Alejandra que levante la suspensión laboral de Irene. Alejandra le dice a Leo que con su padre, Leonardo, son amantes y que por favor guarde el secreto.

programme.desc: En 1887, después de cumplir dos años en la Prisión Territorial de Yuma, acusado injustamente, Hunter Braddock, un hombre virtuoso con un pasado complejo, regresa a la ciudad de Arizona de Far Haven para comenzar de nuevo con sus dos hijos pequeños. Pero cuando su suegro es brutalmente atacado por un grupo de asalto no identificado, Braddock debe enfrentarse a las fuerzas corruptas que estrangulan la ciudad para proteger lo que más ama.

programme.title: County Line: Todo o Nada
programme.desc: Cuando un abogado corrupto, conocido por representar a los peores criminales de área, aparece muerto en la línea del condado, el sheriff de el condado de Maksville Aldel Rockwell pierde la batalla de jurisdicción contra la recién electa Sheriff del condado de York Joanne Jo Porter. Incapaz de dejar de sospechar de un jefe criminal local, Alden sigue su instinto y empieza a investigar el caso en vez de mantener su palabra a la metódica Porter. Siguiendo una pista, cruza la línea del condado, creando hostilidad entre ambos. Pero cuando otro abogado aparece muerto bajo circunstancias misteriosas, la investigación da un giro inesperado. Ambos Sheriffs se dan cuenta de que deben dejar de lado sus diferencias y trabajar juntos para atrapar al asesino.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: En Moscú ocurren asesinatos misteriosos. En cada asesinato se muere el criminal que cometió el crimen anterior... pero el departamento operativo de la policía no logra seguir el rastro del asesino. Además, el comandante altamente profesional Sergey Odintsov no puede trabajar después de haber sido gravemente herido, aunque está tratando de realizar su propia investigación. Los problemas familiares no le permiten concentrarse en el trabajo: su hija está gravemente enferma y se necesita el dinero para medicamentos costosos, su automóvil se daña y no tiene para repararlo... una solución llega inesperadamente como en forma de ganar la lotería, sobre lo cual Elena, la esposa de Sergey, es notificada por SMS. Aunque no todo es tan fácil, porque para obtener esta gran victoria se debe cumplir una condición: matar a una persona...

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: Es evidente que el titiritero conoce bien a los participantes de su cruel juego: por dinero, están dispuestos a todo. Solo una joven parece haber terminado en este grupo por pura coincidencia.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: La oferta impacta a la joven, quien decide contarle todo a su esposo, que es policía.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: Ahora deben encontrar al organizador antes de que ocurra otro asesinato. Para ello, necesitan descubrir qué relación tiene la protagonista con la persona que le han encargado matar. El problema es que ella no tiene la menor idea de quién es esa persona ni qué los une…
